reason: I already drive down to Jbeil every Saturday for the big shop, and the dekkene owner is my neighbour and lets me pay at the end of the month. I don't need someone else doing my shopping.
objection: I can't pay at the end of the month like at the dekkene, and I'd be handing a list to strangers who buy my food and I only find out the price at pickup. On a small income that's a risk.
would_change_my_mind: If they let me pay at the end of the month, showed me the receipt, and I saw a few neighbours using it and saving real money on cartons.
